title: Meta Muse Spaces Build Your Own Mini Apps From a Description
dek: Describe an idea and Meta's Muse AI app builds a personal tool for it.

facts.label: Muse downloads within weeks of launch
Spaces live everywhere Muse is offered

caption:
What if you could build your own app just by describing it? 🛠️

Meta just launched Muse spaces, a new feature in its Muse AI app. Tell Muse what you want, like a gift tracker, trip planner, wedding planner or small business order tracker, and it builds an interactive mini app right inside Muse. You can keep refining it, pin it to the sidebar, hide it, or even schedule when it shows up.

The standout part: spaces can connect to apps you already use and update in the background, so concert dates, price changes or new orders show up without you asking. It's Meta's step toward no-code, vibe-coded personal tools for everyone.

We're tracking every move in the AI assistant race at AI Parabellum. Would you trust Muse with your personal data to make this work?
